## Code with Comments

```python
# This function calculates fibonacci numbers
def fibonacci(n: int) -> int:
    if n <= 1:
        return n
    return fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2)


# Example usage
if __name__ == "__main__":
    for i in range(10):
        print(f"F({i}) = {fibonacci(i)}")
```
